confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors come from aggregated cost-of-living guides and a few venue reports dated 2025 to July 2026, converted at roughly 10 MAD per USD, which fluctuates. Cocktail and wine are weaker: they rely on one bar price and one restaurant review, and cocktail uses the local beer relationship. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates and were not checked against live listings. FX could not be verified against the RBA's F11.1 table; the 0.6976 figure is a third-party report of the RBA 4pm reference for 2026-11-03, and the source_url was not opened.
comparable_city_reasoning: Coastal Moroccan tourist town, benchmarked against Moroccan tourist-town cost-of-living aggregates (Numbeo-derived guides, Al Murakib, Nomad Watch, The Currency Shop) and prices reported for Essaouira venues. Accommodation is a holistic estimate from comparable Moroccan coastal towns.
